title: Crossing the Threshold: How OpenAI and Anthropic Approach Autonomy and Safety in Financial Agents
author: Richard MacManus
description: At AI Engineer New York, frontier labs and financial firms explored how to give agents useful autonomy while keeping consequential decisions under control.
summary: One of the key themes at the AI Engineer New York conference this week was how to balance agent autonomy with security and safety . Both frontier labs and financial firms focused on this issue in their presentations this week.
takeaways: Anthropic: Give agents context, then define the boundaries of trust Anthropic’s presentation outlined a similar framework, in its case with the goal of building “trust” into financial agentic workflows.
Last month, Anthropic announced Claude for Financial Advisors , allowing financial advisors to connect their systems to Claude and a set of workflow skills.

“Check every call, log it, and keep a kill switch.” Go fast and stop safely Even though frontier labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are building a ‘trust framework’ for financial agents, ultimately it’s up to financial firms to put controls around their agents .
